item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 20/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, the weather will be unsettled over southern China in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure edging closer to the coastal areas gradually, showers will be heavy at times with squally thunderstorms over the region early next week. With the trough of low pressure weakening gradually, there will be fewer showers over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Southern China will be affected by a trough of low pressure again in the latter part of next week, there will be thundery showers over the region.
